hero.title: Step on. *Spin.* Smile.
hero.lede: A 360-degree video booth for weddings, festivals, fairs and special occasions. Guests step onto the platform, the camera circles them, and the moment is captured on video.

sections.title: Three steps to *the video everyone wants*

items.title: Step onto the platform
items.text: Guests take their place on the booth's platform.

items.title: The camera circles you
items.text: A full 360-degree spin captures the moment as video.

items.title: Take the moment home
items.text: The spin is recorded as a short video of your guests.

sections.title: Any party that needs *a little spin*

items.title: Weddings
items.text: The booth has spun at wedding receptions around the area.

items.title: Festivals & fairs
items.text: A line that keeps a crowd entertained.

items.title: Special occasions
items.text: Whatever you're celebrating, with custom neon signs and backdrops.

items.a: A platform with a camera on a rotating arm. Guests stand on the platform while the camera circles them, recording a short video.

items.q: Can the backdrop match my event?
items.a: Custom neon signs and backdrops are available. Call to talk through your theme.

items.q: How do I check my date?
items.a: Call (803) 634-6313 with your date and venue.

sections.title: Got a date?
sections.text: Call to book the booth for your event.
